raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Detail-oriented finance professional with experience in transaction processing and client servicing in the mutual fund industry, recently promoted to Senior Transaction Processing Analyst at SS&C GlobeOp for strong accuracy and operational performance. Trained in investment banking operations (Imarticus Learning), covering trade life cycle, AML/KYC, and SWIFT. Seeking to transition into an investment banking operations, compliance, or corporate finance analyst role.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
AML/KYC Compliance | Trade Life Cycle | SWIFT Operations | Reconciliation ● Attention to Detail ● Microsoft Excel (XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) | Word & PowerPoint
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
SS&C GlobeOp | Mumbai, Maharashtra Senior Transaction Processing Analyst Promoted to Senior Transaction Processing Analyst in March 2026 in recognition of consistent accuracy, strong operational performance, and reliability in transaction processing.
March 2026 – Present
Reviewed and rectified processing errors identified in transactions handled by team members, contributing to improved overall data quality and operational accuracy.
Conducted thorough post-processing quality checks to verify transaction completeness, correctness, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
Supported strong operational risk management practices by adhering to control procedures and maintaining high standards of data integrity.
Supported creation and maintenance of investor/trading accounts, validating client information, account attributes, and supporting documentation before system updates.
Supported Standing Settlement Instruction (SSI) creation, amendment and maintenance, ensuring accurate settlement and beneficiary information.
Maintained and validated client/investor master data, ensuring accuracy and consistency across operational systems and records.
Performed detailed reconciliation of transaction and investor data, identified discrepancies and breaks, investigated root causes, and coordinated with relevant teams for timely resolution.
Reviewed and updated client/account information based on approved documentation and transaction requests. ● Collaborated effectively with cross-functional teams to resolve client and operational issues, ensuring smooth and timely transaction execution.
Transaction Processing Analyst
November 2024 – March 2026
Processed a high volume of investor transactions, including subscriptions, switches, and transfers across multiple mutual fund schemes, while ensuring accuracy and strict adherence to operational procedures and compliance standards.
Executed end-to-end transaction processing within defined service level agreements (SLA) and turnaround times (TAT), maintaining efficiency in a fast-paced environment.
Validated trade instructions, investor details, and supporting documentation prior to processing to ensure accuracy and minimize operational and financial risk.
Ensured accurate client onboarding and transaction processing by verifying documentation in line with Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations.
Performed detailed data validation and reconciliations to maintain consistency and integrity across operational systems and records.
● Efficiently managed multiple high-priority tasks simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment while consistently
meeting productivity and quality benchmarks.
Hexaware Technologies | Mumbai, Maharashtra
Senior Executive
July 2023 – March 2024
Managed the end-to-end operations lifecycle from sourcing to onboarding. ● Processed employee onboarding documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion.
Teleperformance Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai, Maharashtra Executive
February 2022 – July 2023
Developed strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. ● Managed high-volume workloads while consistently achieving productivity and quality targets. ● Conducted induction sessions for new hires on process workflows, company policies, and quality standards.
